# Active Safety AI Fall Prevention with VSTAlert

AI that Assists


in Proactively Identifying Falls


VSTAlert by VirtuSense prevents falls with ambient vision AI monitoring — detecting a patient's intent to exit their bed 31–65 seconds before they get up and alerting the right staff immediately. No wearables. No false alarms.

### Alerts, Straight to Your Device

VSTAlert uses Artificial Intelligence and Machine Vision to identify someone's intent to get out of a bed or chair 31-65 seconds before they actually do.

When a patient attempts a bed exit, the automated alert workflow notifies the assigned nurses and techs as well as the floor’s central console, all within one second. If there is no response to the alert, a contingency protocol escalates the alert to the rest of the team on that floor.

[Request a demo](https://www.virtusense.ai/request-a-demo)

### Secure

VSTAlert allows you to provide the best care for your residents with fewer staff while remaining 100% HIPAA-Compliant. VSTAlert uses LiDAR-based ambient vision sensors to detect movement and fall risk — with no cameras, no stored video, and full HIPAA compliance. Patient data is never transmitted or saved by the device.

[Call To Action](https://www.giantfocal.com/)

## 98% Detection Accuracy Before a Bed Exit

For standard bed alarm devices, detection accuracy can be as low as 15%. Not only do these frequent false alarms disturb nurses and staff, but it can also add stress to patients. VSTAlert sends real-time alerts to nurses and staff within a second of a bed exit with 98% accuracy.

Traditional bed and chair pads generate 20–30 false alarms per bed per day — contributing to alarm fatigue and nurse burnout. VSTAlert eliminates 95% of those alarms, so when an alert fires, your team knows it matters.

![Floor management-1](https://www.virtusense.ai/hubfs/Floor%20management-1.png)

![Group 154 copy](https://www.virtusense.ai/hubfs/Group%20154%20copy.png)

## Simple Floor Management

The VSTAlert Console allows you to manage your entire floor from a single screen. You can assign rooms to nurses and staff, track shifts, onboard patients, and view the status of each room in real-time.

## What does getting VSTAlert look like?

### Demo

You'll talk with one our product specialists to find out how VSTAlert can best impact your organization, and we'll walk you through the options that fit your specific needs.

### Deployment

We'll be with you every step of the deployment process, providing processes and training materials for your staff to help them learn how to use the technology.

### Fall Reduction Almost Immediately

It doesn't take long to start seeing the results. VirtuSense clients see up to an 80% reduction in falls in as little as three months — with never events eliminated and nursing teams focused on care, not alarms.

### Support

## FAQs

#### Do I need VSTAlert for all of my certified beds?

No. We recommend 20-25% of SNF beds be equipped with VSTAlert for maximum usage and efficiency.

#### Is it HIPAA compliant?

VSTAlert is 100% HIPAA-compliant. Unlike video surveillance, AI sensors aren’t cameras and don’t record patients.

#### Does it use a camera?

VSTAlert uses an infrared sensor to monitor the resident. There is no video streaming.

#### How long does it take to install?

Our team will work with yours over the course of a few weeks to make sure that VSTAlert operates properly and that your staff is trained and comfortable using the technology.

#### Can it monitor chair exits?

Yes, VSTAlert can be set up to detect both bed and chair exits.

#### What if some residents crawl out of bed slowly or a different way than others?

The AI algorithm will learn the habits of the resident it is monitoring and adjust the alerts accordingly. We can also make the requirements for an Alert more or less strict if your staff requests it.

#### What is the required Wi-Fi bandwidth for VSTAlert?

27MB per sensor per 24 hours
